content.short: Ensuro is a decentralized insurance protocol using liquidity pools to underwrite real-world risk coverage.
content.description: Ensuro is a decentralized insurance protocol that uses DeFi liquidity pools to support underwriting for insurance products. The project aims to let more people participate in insurance markets while helping companies deploy coverage for underserved or uncovered communities. Capital providers supply liquidity that can back risk, while insurance partners can build products on top of the protocol. Ensuro's Cardano listing reflects its role as a DeFi and real-world risk platform rather than a conventional exchange.
